[Booking Support Ticket #BK-51092]
Customer: Meridian Consulting Group (contact: T. Alvarez)
Service: Riverside Conference Hall, half-day booking, capacity 80

Booking history: Meridian Consulting Group has booked the Riverside Conference Hall four times in the past year. Feb 3: a half-day strategy offsite for 40 people, no issues, fee paid in full and the room returned in good condition. May 14: a half-day training session, originally booked for May 7 but rescheduled once at Meridian's request with more than 48 hours' notice, so no fee impact applied under the reschedule rule. Jul 22: a planned board meeting that was cancelled 9 days ahead of the event due to a scheduling conflict on Meridian's side, and was refunded in full per the standard policy. And the current booking, described below.

Current booking: scheduled for Sep 20, 2026, 9:00am-1:00pm, booking fee $1,200.00, confirmed Aug 15, 2026, for a half-day client workshop. The confirmation email on file also lists optional add-ons that were declined at booking time: catering ($400.00) and A/V technician support ($150.00); neither add-on was purchased, so only the base $1,200.00 booking fee is at issue here.

Venue coordinator notes (logged Aug 20, unrelated to the refund decision): room set up as boardroom-style for 80, projector and screen confirmed working, parking validation arranged for attendees. These setup details are recorded for planning purposes only and do not affect cancellation eligibility.

Cancellation request received: Sep 18, 2026, 10:15am, via email from T. Alvarez: 'I need to cancel our Sep 20 booking. I know this is short notice.' T. Alvarez did not provide any additional reason for the cancellation beyond short notice; no documentation of any kind was submitted with the request.

For reference, Meridian's account also has a separate, older booking-tier note on file from a legacy contract (expired Dec 2025) that allowed partial refunds — specifically 50% of the booking fee — for cancellations within 48 hours, but only for bookings under a now-discontinued 'Flex Hall' product tier that Meridian is no longer enrolled in. That legacy tier does not apply to the Riverside Conference Hall or to any current bookings, and is mentioned here only because it still appears in the account history and might otherwise cause confusion about a partial refund that is not actually available under the current agreement.

Policy reference: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the scheduled event start receive a full refund of the booking fee. Cancellations within 48 hours forfeit the booking fee, except when accompanied by documentation of a medical emergency affecting the primary attendee, in which case the fee is waived regardless of timing. This exception applies only to a medical emergency affecting the primary attendee personally; general business disruptions, weather, or scheduling conflicts are not covered by this exception and are handled under the standard more-than/within-48-hours rule above.

Support agent's calculation: the event was scheduled for Sep 20 at 9:00am. The cancellation request arrived Sep 18 at 10:15am. That is 46 hours and 45 minutes before the event start, which falls inside the 48-hour window.

Additional note from the account manager: Meridian is a long-standing customer with no prior late cancellations — the Jul 22 cancellation was 9 days ahead, well outside the 48-hour window, and was refunded under the standard rule, not any exception. The account manager also confirmed there are no other open bookings, outstanding invoices, or disputes on this account that would affect this decision, and that Meridian's billing contact remains T. Alvarez for any refund issued.

Ticket status: awaiting refund decision, to be recorded in the billing system once made and communicated back to T. Alvarez by end of day.
